subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The museum visit taught the student that old objects are not just decorations.”?
options: They are answers to problems people once faced.
Problems are easier to fix when people look closely.
A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.
What feels old now was once powerful enough to change how people imagined the world.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The museum visit taught the student that old objects are not just decorations. They are answers to problems people once faced.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Problems are easier to fix when people look closely.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「What feels old now was once powerful enough to change how people imagined the world.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The museum visit taught the student that old objects are not just decorations. They are answers to problems people once faced.」，答案為「They are answers to problems people once faced.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They are answers to problems people once faced.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
